title: Rainmaker
season_arc: Tara's machine makes her village the first place in decades with free water, and the company that owns the rain comes to take it back.

characters.name: Tara
characters.personality: Blunt, fearless, counts her failures, loves her grandfather more than she says
characters.voice: Clear, quick young girl's voice with dry humour
characters.visual_block: Tara, a 13-year-old Indian girl with two short messy braids, a smudge of dust on her cheek, sharp curious eyes, wearing a patched indigo kurta, an orange scarf around her neck and welding goggles pushed up on her forehead

episodes.title: Rainmaker, Ep 1: Attempt 41
episodes.summary: In 2099 Rajasthan, where a company sells every drop of water, a 13-year-old girl builds a machine from scrap that makes it rain, and the company notices.
episodes.cliffhanger: Company tanker drones turn toward the village while Tara refuses to hide the machine.
